main_claim: After beating Soriano, Donchenko says he wants Daniel Rodriguez next, ideally at the last event of the year.
quote: "Please, let me fight just with him," Donchenko said
note: The article is built on his callout, which is a wish, so no_fact; the decision win over Soriano is told as the setting. An editor could instead read this next-day piece as carrying the result as news (fact result, official_or_done).

main_claim: Spanish reporter Alvaro Colmenero says Topuria will return to the public eye in September.
quote: "I do know that Ilia is going to return to the public eye directly in the month of September."
note: A named reporter states he is coming back into public after time away; no specific fight is reported, the Gaethje/Pimblett lines are closing background.

main_claim: Donchenko vs Soriano is listed on the main card of UFC Paris in a start-time and how-to-watch guide.
quote: Welterweight: Daniil Donchenko vs Punahele Soriano
note: He appears only as a line in the card list; card order and start times are fight-week routine, so fight_week_event. Rule 3 calls a booking restated in a card list background, so no_fact / none is equally defensible.

main_claim: UFC commentator Jon Anik says the UFC is having internal conversations about an immediate Gaethje vs Topuria rematch.
quote: "I think there are internal conversations to potentially try to do Gaethje vs. Topuria 2."
note: Talks about a specific fight, with a named speaker, so next_fight. Firmness rumour because it is 'I think' and 'internal conversations'; reported is possible since a named person states it.

main_claim: Makhachev reveals he agreed to fight Topuria at the White House event but it fell through, he says because Topuria's side asked for more money.
quote: "Decía que les ofrecieron la pelea, preguntaron por más dinero, no se lo dieron y por eso eligieron no pelear conmigo"
note: none_of_these: a past negotiation revealed (a fight that was offered and never happened), which is neither one of the six nor where he stands now. An editor could call an offered-then-dropped fight next_fight, but it concerns an event already past.

main_claim: Gaethje, who is out until 2027, guesses Topuria will not fight until next year either and does not think the rematch is his next fight.
quote: "I guess if I'm not fighting until next year, [Topuria is] probably not going to fight until next year, too"
note: Another fighter's guess at his timing and a gut feeling about the rematch are opinion, not a fact about him.

main_claim: Topuria's favourite restaurant in Spain is Nou Collonet on the island of Tabarca.
quote: El lugar predilecto de Topuria para disfrutar de la gastronomía de nuestro país es el restaurante Nou Collonet
note: Life outside the cage. The outlet states it without quoting him, so reported; official_or_done would fit if the preference is taken as coming from him.

main_claim: Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but nobody has spoken to him about it.
quote: "Nothing yet. No one's spoke to me about it, so we'll see what happens."
note: The rumour is only 'rumors swirling' with no who, date or event, so by the guide this is a wish piece. An editor could treat a denied rumour as next_fight at rumour firmness, next fight yes.

main_claim: Donchenko and Soriano faced off at the UFC Fight Night 287 ceremonial weigh-ins.
quote: Daniil Donchenko vs. Punahele Soriano, UFC Fight Night 287 ceremonial weigh-ins faceoff
note: The saved text is only the headline plus site furniture; the headline reports a weigh-in face-off. Unsure because with no body an editor could say there is no content and so no_fact.

main_claim: Topuria speaks publicly for the first time since losing the belt, in a video message to his son Hugo about not fearing defeat.
quote: Las primeras palabras de Ilia Topuria después de perder el cinturón de campeón de peso ligero a mediados de junio han ido dirigidas a una persona en particular, Hugo, su hijo.
note: The thing that happened is that he is back in public after nearly three months of silence, so status_update. The message itself is a life lesson to his son, so personal_life is a reasonable other pick; the facial injuries are recalled as background.

main_claim: In an essay Topuria reflects on his loss to Gaethje, states the fractures he suffered and says the defeat made him want to return more.
quote: las dos órbitas de los ojos fracturadas, el tabique y el pie rotos
note: He himself lists his injuries inside the essay the article is built on, which the guide rules as health. The essay is mainly reflection, so an editor could pick no_fact or status_update (he wants to come back).

main_claim: Topuria writes on his website about his first loss, naming the fractures he suffered and saying his passion to fight grew.
quote: both orbital bones fractured, my septum broken, and my foot broken
note: Same essay: his own statement of his injuries is the one hard fact in it, so health by the guide's ruling. Mostly reflection, so no_fact is the other reasonable reading.

main_claim: After the official weigh-in Donchenko says he made weight, is fine, and plans to be about 86 kg by the evening.
quote: Обидва бійці показали вагу 77,11 кг.
note: Weigh-in news and his comments after it; the fight with Soriano is the premise, not new, so next fight is no.

main_claim: Topuria's conditioning coach Jesús Gallo says his recovery is going remarkably well and that he could be ready by December, though spring 2027 is the sensible target.
quote: "tiene un poder de recuperación increíble"
note: A named team member states how the recovery is going, so health even though he also gives a return window. If the timing is read as the main point it would be status_update.

main_claim: Pimblett says nobody from the UFC has spoken to him about a December fight with Topuria, after Tim Welch said he had heard rumours of it.
quote: Tim Welch, who coaches Sean O'Malley , claimed he heard rumors that Pimblett and Topuria could meet before the end of the year.
note: A rumour with substance (who said it, and a December date), denied by its subject: next_fight at rumour firmness.

main_claim: Pimblett says he has had no call about the rumoured UFC 335 fight with Topuria on December 12; Jon Anik speaks of internal talks about a Gaethje rematch instead.
quote: Sean O'Malley 's coach, Tim Welch , recently claimed to have heard rumors of the potential matchup taking place on December 12.
note: The rumour has a named source, an event and a date, and is denied by Pimblett; the Anik talks are a second rumour of the same kind.

main_claim: Donchenko will fight Punahele Soriano on 5 September at UFC Fight Night in Paris.
quote: Данило Донченко проведе свій наступний поєдинок 5 вересня на турнірі UFC Fight Night у Парижі.
note: A booking stated flatly as set, with date, event and opponent. No source is named, so reported is possible instead of official_or_done.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and that both a Gaethje rematch and a Pimblett fight suit the UFC.
quote: "Topuria está listo para pelear, y nosotros estamos preparados para él."
note: The promotion states he is ready, with opponents named only as options; the injury list and the 2027 timing are the writer's own additions.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight, that nothing is scheduled yet, and that both Gaethje and Pimblett are good options.
quote: "No lo tenemos en la agenda por ahora, pero escucha: Topuria está listo para pelea. Nosotros estamos listos para él"
note: Ready, nothing booked, opponents as options: all status_update, stated by the promotion. 'Parece que está recuperado' is the writer's inference, not health news.

main_claim: Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but nobody has talked to him about it, in a piece weighing Topuria's two possible next opponents.
quote: «Nadie me ha hablado de eso (una pelea con Ilia), así que veremos qué pasa»
note: The talk of a Pimblett fight comes from unnamed 'corrillos' with no date or event, and the rest is the writer's analysis and Pimblett's wish, so no_fact. The passing line that Jon Anik is asserting the Gaethje rematch will happen could be read as a named rumour (next_fight, rumour, yes).
